import sqlite3

# Get events with >10 attendees from attendance.csv
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
c = conn.cursor()

# Create table for attendance counts
c.execute('''CREATE TABLE attendance_counts (event_id TEXT, member_count INTEGER)''')

# Events with >10 members from n1 summary
high_attendance_events = [
    ('recykdvf4LgsyA3wZ', 30),
    ('recLKj8BbTNqxFbTb', 30),
    ('recEVTik3MlqbvLFi', 29),
    ('reczhS8wix6Kzbp9P', 27),
    ('reciRZdAqNIKuMC96', 27),
    ('recI43CzsZ0Q625ma', 27),
    ('recmbOVHSyzXQZpQr', 25),
    ('recggMW2eyCYceNcy', 23),
    ('rec5XDvJLyxDsGZWc', 20),
    ('recvCUOytx5jPw7kh', 17),
    ('rec2N69DMcrqN9PJC', 17),
    ('recGxVCwaLW3mDIa3', 14),
    ('recIuIXdbLe5j5vCA', 12),
    ('recsgSUqFCJqekzL5', 11)
]

c.executemany('INSERT INTO attendance_counts VALUES (?, ?)', high_attendance_events)

# Load event types from db/event.db
conn2 = sqlite3.connect('db/event.db')
c2 = conn2.cursor()
c2.execute('SELECT event_id, type FROM event')
events = c2.fetchall()
conn2.close()

# Create events table in memory
c.execute('''CREATE TABLE events (event_id TEXT, type TEXT)''')
c.executemany('INSERT INTO events VALUES (?, ?)', events)

# Join and filter for meetings with >10 attendees
c.execute('''
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM attendance_counts ac
    JOIN events e ON ac.event_id = e.event_id
    WHERE e.type = 'Meeting' AND ac.member_count > 10
''')
result = c.fetchone()[0]
print(result)
